title: A multitask learning framework for leveraging subjectivity of annotators to identify misogyny

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting misogynistic content in tweets and modeling annotator subjectivity by incorporating the differing perspectives of male and female annotators as auxiliary tasks in a multitask learning framework.
Mitigating annotator demographic bias by using the labels of different annotator age groups (18-22, 23-45, and 46+) as auxiliary tasks to capture generational subjectivity in misogyny identification.
